title: Message/get ids=null design deviation needs explicit documentation
description: Message/get intentionally rejects ids=null (v1 design choice to prevent full-table scans) but this deviates from RFC 8620 section 5.1 without any comment explaining the departure. The test name says 'v1 requirement' but the RFC says ids=null is valid. Future maintainers will not know if the rejection is intentional or a bug. Fix: add a comment explaining the deliberate deviation and the intended migration path (e.g. add pagination then enable null ids).
